description: Composite design-quality scorer (UICraftScore). Combines three deterministic dimensions into a single 0-100 score + letter grade (A/B/C/D/F) + per-dimension subscores and findings. Dimensions: anti-slop (38 rules via ui-craft-detect), token-discipline (raw hex / off-scale values), and static a11y (5 checks: img-no-alt, non-semantic-interactive, positive-tabindex, aria-invalid-no-describedby, no-reduced-motion). Accepts either a `code` string (inline source) or a `path` string (file). Formula: score = 100 − (antiSlop_crit×8) − (antiSlop_major×4) − (antiSlop_warn×1) − (token_findings×2) − (a11y_crit×8) − (a11y_major×4), clamped [0,100]. Returns { overall: {score, grade}, dimensions: {anti_slop, token_discipline, a11y}, version }.

code.description: Inline source code to score (alternative to path)

path.description: File path to score (alternative to code)
